facts.text: I was looking for information on Abstract Expressionism.
I participated in a guided tour at the Modern Art Gallery focused on the Abstract Expressionism movement recently.
I was particularly interested in the works of Pollock and Rothko during my guided tour.
I was curious about the techniques Pollock used to create his drip effect.
I was curious about Rothko's color field approach.
I was curious to know more about the artistic movements that preceded Abstract Expressionism.
I was curious about the influences of Surrealism and Cubism on the development of Abstract Expressionism.
I was curious about how Surrealism and Cubism shaped the ideas and techniques of artists like Pollock and Rothko.
I was curious to know more about the role of the artist's inner world and emotions in Abstract Expressionism.
I was curious about how Pollock and Rothko's personal experiences and emotions shaped their art.
I was curious to know more about the role of the viewer in Abstract Expressionism.
I was interested in how Abstract Expressionist artists like Pollock and Rothko thought about the viewer's experience.
I was interested in how Abstract Expressionist artists sought to engage with their audience.
I asked how the Abstract Expressionist movement influenced the development of art in subsequent decades.
I asked whether Abstract Expressionism paved the way for other art movements and which ones.
